My plot is very small, just a tiny piece behind the house, and I plant maize together with cassava and some melon like I always do. I have no money for fertilizer from the shop — one bag is too much for this small ground and the price is high, so I just put the goat droppings and kitchen ash I gather through the year. I keep my own maize seed from last harvest like my mother taught me, and my children help me weed when they come back from the farm. The rain comes on its own here, so I do not carry water, and I pull the weeds with my hoe instead of buying that chemical.
